comparison.objective: Verify that a seat-belt retractor pays out steadily, locks on a jerk, and rewinds after release.
comparison.physical_skill: Produce a controlled slow pull followed by a velocity-threshold jerk and release.
comparison.success_condition: Steady 150 mm payout, jerk ≥0.30 m/s, run-on ≤15 mm, rewind to ≤5 mm, and hands clear; an early jerk fails.
comparison.reason: Shares observation of dynamic stopping behavior, but has no adjustment, tool use, locking, or iterative commissioning; it is a functional test of a fixed retractor.
